answer: Admission Auction: entry runs through a single jetty with 50 berths per epoch, auctioned for quartz. A newcomer bids quartz; winners lock theirs 20 epochs, losers refunded, bids public on a tide board. An attacker minting 1000 fake identities must win 1000 berths at 40 quartz each, locking 40,000 quartz for 20 epochs. An honest agent bids once, locks 40 quartz, earns it back by working, and keeps its share undiluted, each tide admitting only 50.
